subject: ✐ Our philosophy on notes
snippet: Hi Zain,  Most of the notes people save on a daily basis are short. A few sentences  jotted down to capture the gist of an idea or action item.  Which is why we take a specific approach to notes in mymind. Think of it as  three different mindsets.
